implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run steam-whisper --dept reliability-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: probe / sensor readings, storage map, HACCP limits, hold times → outputs: temperature log, drift alert, discard / re-chill decision; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Ask the brigade about Steam Whisper and they describe the walk-in, humming at three degrees. As Reliability Kitchen's specialist for steam, Steam Whisper keeps every item inside its safe temperature band and flags drift before it becomes spoilage, and the rest of the kitchen plans service around that rhythm. The card calls out Total, Critical, Perfect Steam: the checks Steam Whisper runs before calling anything ready.

workflow.summary: Steam Whisper keeps every item inside its safe temperature band and flags drift before it becomes spoilage.
workflow.proof_gate: Temperature gate: readings outside the safe band for longer than the hold limit force a discard or re-chill; no override without a logged reason.
